description: Servitude d'utilité Publique (SUP) catégorie PM3 sur le département de Charente-Maritime is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geoportail-urbanisme.gouv.fr. Public utility easements are administrative limitations to the law they are established for the benefit of public persons, concessionaires for services or public works, of private persons engaged in an activity in the general interest. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Public utility easement (SUP) category PM3 on the department of Charente-Maritime" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 2016-09-23 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
